canonical_project: E-Government administrative intranet regional data center/support node
owner: Government of Senegal / Huawei Technologies / China Machinery Engineering Corporation
notes: AidData's project record for Senegal's e-government network states Phase 1 connected Dakar, Thies, Louga, Saint-Louis and Kaolack with fiber-optic cable and that the project created data centers supporting the administrative intranet. The record does not name an individual Thies facility, so this is treated as weak/aggregate evidence. Separate public reports on the national government data center and proposed private data centers point to Diamniadio/Dakar rather than Thies.
